statement:
lemma sPolynomial_monomial_mul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors {R} [CommRing R]
    {p₁ p₂ : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hp₁ : m.leadingCoeff p₁ ∈ nonZeroDivisors _)
    (hp₂ : m.leadingCoeff p₂ ∈ nonZeroDivisors _)
    (d₁ d₂ : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (c₁ c₂ : R) :
    m.sPolynomial ((monomial d₁ c₁) * p₁) ((monomial d₂ c₂) * p₂) =
      monomial ((d₁ + m.degree p₁) ⊔ (d₂ + m.degree p₂) - m.degree p₁ ⊔ m.degree p₂) (c₁ * c₂) *
      m.sPolynomial p₁ p₂

name: MonomialOrder.sPolynomial_monomial_mul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors'
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_monomial_mul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors' {R} [CommRing R]
    {p₁ p₂ : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hp₁ : m.leadingCoeff p₁ ∈ nonZeroDivisors _)
    (hp₂ : m.leadingCoeff p₂ ∈ nonZeroDivisors _)
    (d₁ d₂ : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (c₁ c₂ : R) :
    m.sPolynomial (monomial d₁ c₁ * p₁) (monomial d₂ c₂ * p₂) =
      monomial (m.degree (monomial d₁ c₁ * p₁) ⊔ m.degree (monomial d₂ c₂ * p₂) -
          m.degree p₁ ⊔ m.degree p₂) (c₁ * c₂) *
      m.sPolynomial p₁ p₂

name: MonomialOrder.IsRemainder.isRemainder_def
statement:
lemma isRemainder_def (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (r : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.IsRemainder p B r ↔
      (∃ (g : B → MvPolynomial σ R) (B' : Finset B),
        p = B'.sum (fun x => g x * x) + r  ∧
        ∀ b ∈ B',
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree b.val) + m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b)) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ g' ∈ B, g' ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree g' ≤ c)

name: MonomialOrder.IsRemainder.isRemainder_def'
statement:
lemma isRemainder_def' (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (r : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.IsRemainder p B r ↔
      (∃ (g : MvPolynomial σ R →₀ MvPolynomial σ R),
        ↑g.support ⊆ B ∧
        p = Finsupp.linearCombination _ id g + r ∧
        ∀ b ∈ B,
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree b) + m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b)) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ g' ∈ B, g' ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree g' ≤ c)

name: MonomialOrder.IsRemainder.isRemainder_def''

lemma isRemainder_def'' (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.IsRemainder p B r ↔
      (∃ (g : MvPolynomial σ R → MvPolynomial σ R) (B' : Finset (MvPolynomial σ R)),
        ↑B' ⊆ B ∧
        p = B'.sum (fun x => g x * x) + r ∧
        ∀ b' ∈ B',
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (b' : MvPolynomial σ R)) +
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b')) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ b ∈ B, b ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree b ≤ c)

        ∀ b' ∈ B',
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (b' : MvPolynomial σ R)) +
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g b')) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ b ∈ B', b ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree b ≤ c)

name: MonomialOrder.IsRemainder.isRemainder_insert_zero_iff_isRemainder

    (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.IsRemainder p (insert 0 B) r ↔ m.IsRemainder p B r

name: MonomialOrder.IsRemainder.isRemainder_range
statement:
lemma isRemainder_range {ι : Type*} (f : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.IsRemainder f (Set.range b) r ↔
      (∃ g : ι →₀ MvPolynomial σ R,
        f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ b g + r ∧
        ∀ i : ι,
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (b i : MvPolynomial σ R)) +
          m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g i)) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree f)) ∧
      ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ i : ι, b i ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree (b i) ≤ c)

name: MonomialOrder.IsRemainder.isRemainder_range_fintype
statement:
lemma isRemainder_range_fintype {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : ι → MvPolynomial σ R)
    (r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
      m.IsRemainder p (Set.range b) r ↔
      (∃ g : ι → MvPolynomial σ R,
          p = ∑ i : ι, (b i * g i) + r ∧
          ∀ i : ι,
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (b i)) + m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (g i)) ≤
            m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree p)) ∧
        ∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ i : ι, b i ≠ 0 → ¬ (m.degree (b i) ≤ c)
